root_cause_analysis.symptom: Cycle session 20260505 closed with: 27 schema validation failures, 134 image_url leak vectors, 26 additionalProperties:true gaps, 12 data pollution categories, 30+ placeholder regression KEYS lingering through 3 PASS verdicts, dual write paths for image_url, renderer split-honoring (3 of 7 POI types), wrong .claude/skills/... path strings, warning-only prompt-purity, no integrity verifier, no agent ownership, no command frontmatter contract.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Layered structural gaps that allow: (a) data shape silently accepts arbitrary fields (additionalProperties:true at 26 sites); (b) image data has 3 independent write paths with no single contract; (c) renderer code paths diverge for image handling; (d) orchestrator improvises script invocations because there's no canonical command discovery contract; (e) prompt-purity hook is warning-only so orchestrator's own seed words ('include placeholder entries') flow through; (f) no deploy-blocking verifier so 27 schema failures + 30+ placeholder KEYs ship through 3 PASS verdicts; (g) agents have no positive ownership declarations so any agent can write any file. Single root cause: the cycle has structural gaps where a single deploy-blocking gate + a single ownership hook + a single discovery preamble would have caught them all.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: Multi-cycle accretion; not a single regression commit. Recent context: c77d922, 088102b, cfca66d are auto-commits within the failing session 20260505.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Iterative feature additions without architectural gates; each symptom got a renderer band-aid (C1-C10) instead of a structural fix. Spec Section 5.2 'lesson' confirms: orchestrator's failures stemmed not from any specific bug but from acting before researching the project's existing commands/scripts/skills.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: 30+ rejected bespoke hooks would be needed if each symptom got its own hook. Codex consensus: extend ONE verify-plan-integrity.py + ONE pretool-write hook + ONE existing posttool-doc-sync hook. Mathematically simpler, structurally sound.
